$comment: Design Engineering Toolkit converter family — ComponentBindingMap. Major version 1. Versioned, per-project mapping from design-source components (with variant conditions) to exact target capabilities plus prop transforms and fallback policy. Unmatched variants produce explicit UNSUPPORTED-class results, never guessed styling. Both target fields are REQUIRED: no implicit appearance guessing.
title: Design Engineering Toolkit — Component Binding Map

platformId.description: Must equal the pinned registry's platformId.

registryRevisionId.description: Bindings are valid relative to this pinned registry revision; the resolver rejects mismatched revisions (EVIDENCE_MISSING-class failure). Registries and maps are immutable once pinned.

bindings.description: Sorted by sourceComponentId, then canonical variantConditions serialization.

diagnostics.description: Validation findings (DUPLICATE_BINDING, AMBIGUOUS_BINDING, MISSING_REQUIRED_PROP, ...), sorted by the canonical diagnostic order.

bindingId.description: Computed identity: 'b-' + first 12 lowercase hex of SHA-256 over sourceComponentId, canonical variantConditions, target.capabilityId, target.appearanceId (joined by U+241F). Deterministic; report references use it.

sourceComponentId.description: Vocabulary is declared per stage, not hardcoded: G1 uses V1 component-defs components[].id values; G2 uses NodeIR node ids of kind 'component'. Both grammars match this pattern.

variantConditions.description: May be empty (matches all variants). Sorted by (prop, value).

target.description: Both required — no implicit appearance guessing.

fallbackPolicy.description: Closed enum. 'fail-unsupported' is the default semantics: explicit UNSUPPORTED with location/reason, never approximation.

to.description: Target acceptedProps name (payload paths allowed, e.g. items[].title). The semantic validator checks existence (MISSING_REQUIRED_PROP otherwise).

map.description: Value-to-value mapping; object keys are content, hash-sorted. For transform 'map'.

required.description: true when the target prop is mandatory for a valid mapping.
